name: Clover Panties
source:
This is your chance. No more excuses. You’ll finally make your dream come true. You’re determined to find love, and what better place to start than your college campus?

With a lucky four-leaf clover in hand, fate is on your side. Will you finally build up the courage to confess to your crush? Or will an unexpected spark reignite the affection between you and your childhood friend?

Navigate the ups and downs of college life while balancing relationships with two captivating girls. And don’t forget about your goofy but reliable best friend — or the teacher who's dead set on making your life miserable.

Jump into the chaos of college life and see if you’ve got what it takes!

[From [url=https://sweet-sennin-games.itch.io/clover-panties]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
这是你的机会。不再有任何借口。你最终会实现你的梦想。你决心寻找爱情，还有什么比大学校园更好的起点呢？

手上有幸运四叶草，命运就在你身边。你最终能鼓起勇气向暗恋的人表白吗？或者，一场意想不到的火花会重新点燃你和儿时好友之间的感情吗？

应对大学生活的起起落落，同时平衡与两个迷人女孩的关系。别忘了你那傻乎乎但可靠的好朋友，或者是一心想让你的生活变得悲惨的老师。

跳入混乱的大学生活，看看你是否能胜任！

[来自[url=https://sweet-sennin-games.itch.io/clover-panties]itch.io[/url]]
